 PC Jeweller jumps 8% on rise in Q2 profit and debt-free status
 The company posted a ​more ‌than 50% jump in quarterly profit and ‌said ​it had fully ⁠repaid debt owed ‌to a 14-bank consortium.
 By Reuters 
 Updated - October 22, 2026 at 10:17 AM. × Share
 WhatsApp X Facebook LinkedIn Messenger Reddit Mail https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/pc-jeweller-jumps-8-on-rise-in-q2-profit-and-debt-free-status/article71610070.ece Copy Shares ​of PC ‌Jeweller rose
as ​much ⁠as 8.6% to their ‌highest since May ‌2018 ‌on ⁠Thursday,
after ⁠the company posted a ​more ‌than 50% jump in quarterly profit and ‌said ​it had fully ⁠repaid debt owed ‌to a 14-bank consortium.
 Shares were trading 4.1% higher ‌at 19.2 ​rupees as of ⁠9:20
am.
